evidence.quote: And as briefly as possible he detailed the experiences of the last few days. All traces of displeasure had now left his face.
Half-way through, Mr. Carter interrupted him to give a few cryptic orders through the telephone.

adjudications.reason: In the revision, 'his face' directly follows a sentence whose subject is Tommy, so the softened frown can attach to the wrong man. The cut also removes the only on-page cause of the police presence at Soho. Restoring the source sentence fixes both problems.

evidence.quote: They are quite right to keep you here.”
“I dare not, monsieur; I am afraid of them.”
“They’re a bad lot, Annette. If you’ll help me, I’ll take you away from

adjudications.reason: Annette now has two consecutive speech paragraphs with nothing between them. Her 'I dare not' was the answer to Tommy's offer to take her away, and that offer has been cut. Restoring his line puts the turn-taking back and gives her fear a temptation to refuse.

evidence.quote: She raised a hand and turned out the light.
From the way she had studiously avoided looking at him, and her action with the light, he came to the conclusion that the room was overlooked.

adjudications.reason: All the planned elements survive: she turns out the light, mocks him in the dark (V6), and slips him the knife. Tommy's inference from 'her action with the light' is also intact. Conrad's challenge to her is a nice touch, but losing it is a legitimate tradeoff under the word budget.

evidence.quote: As regards Annette he could do nothing.
“I can’t believe she’s really one of them, sir. She--seemed so

adjudications.reason: The motive for running back can still be inferred. She has just vanished and cried out from upstairs, and the text then says 'As regards Annette he could do nothing.' Tommy's dissent to Carter is not listed in the plan. Restoring it would deepen the scene, but it does not repair anything the reader needs, so it was not restored given the word budget.

evidence.quote: But they must have found out about me suddenly

adjudications.reason: The book context names 'the Sunday timing of Tommy's exposure' as a seed. Tommy's 'suddenly' is that seed, and Chapter 020 picks it up with 'not earlier than Sunday afternoon'. Restoring it costs one sentence.

evidence.quote: Why not let this kind gentleman here cut my throat without delay?”
“Nothing,” said Tommy, “could be plainer than your words--unless it was your face.”

adjudications.reason: The plan explicitly allows the lunch scene to be cut to one exchange. Tommy's bravado survives elsewhere, in the throat-cutting quip and the 'unless it was your face' quip. This is an authorised artistic tradeoff.

remaining_concerns: The estimated net change is about 43 words removed, short of the 85 needed. Reaching the target would mean cutting essential clues or voice-bearing quips, so the draft is left roughly 40 words over.
Tommy's dissent to Carter ('I can't believe she's really one of them') remains cut. It could be restored if more budget becomes available.
